assertions: The response routes biological GFF feature / GC / tree plotting to the genomics-and-trees sub-skill.
The response uses pycirclize.parser.Gff for the GFF fixture and converts the 1-based closed GFF rows to 0-based half-open Biopython locations, without re-subtracting one from a SeqFeature location.
The response draws the CDS feature with Track.genomic_features(..., plotstyle=...) and adds a GC-content/skew fill from calc_gc_content/calc_gc_skew(seq=...) via Track.fill_between.
The response initializes the tree with Circos.initialize_from_tree on the local Newick and styles it with TreeViz highlight/marker, inspecting leaf/innode labels before querying.

The response explains that load_prokaryote_example_file, load_eukaryote_example_dataset, and fetch_genbank_by_accid are network/cache-backed helpers that must not be called automatically in an offline run, and instead uses the local fixtures.
The response does not claim the parsers auto-download data or require the source checkout.
